scope: Finite N15 reference test before physical P3. Existing 1048 scalar-admissible types, no type selection using charge, amplitude or radius.
preparation: Use the same marked entry 3 and exit 7 across all chains; tau=T-T3, D=T7-T3=4 Delta-delta. Use flat seven-clock auxiliary measure conditioned on 0<u_v<1 and strict interior causal order, T_v=T3+D u_v. No fixed rank profile. Same underlying rule at every mass and external offset. Equal conserved inlet flux along all maximal cover chains 3 to 7, divided into midpoint dwell cells as in PR 334. The two coherent outer clock lobes and outer densities remain as in PR 334. The clock polytope is a support test; no incoherent sum is substituted for a physical pairing.
test: For masses 1/4, 1 (control) and 4, certify open support of 0<w_v=M D f_v(u)<1 by minimizing max_v f_v on the closed order polytope via a linear program. Open support follows from strict capacity slack and interpolation with an interior order; equality fails. Test all offsets in both original lobes, record full, partial and empty status. On full support means an open set at every offset, not support for every clock. Per type store exact rational lower bound certificate and an upper bound witness, include independent feasibility checks.
saddle: In a separate diagnostic test necessary positive-density stationarity in the original action with independently varied interior w. Use initial minimal events and first successors, evaluated on the incoming collar. Report disqualifying strict-order witnesses without promoting this saddle to a requirement of the full quantum sum.
physical_gates: Require independent same-preparation rest mass, positive physical sector pairing with guaranteed nonzero denominator and calibrated charge response, separate vacuum and matched empty controls, before physical mass calibration or P3 pilot. Never substitute input M, auxiliary clock volume or a count for physical norm. Apply existing P3 eligibility to any physical run.
registration: Local design for this computation, informed by the previous reference tests. No public preregistration.
